quality.basis: 逻辑漏洞：单元测试改为读 PoV 的驱动程序，按输出差分判定

ground_truth_evidence: category 5: the dataset's own trigger (newplatform_bundles/conversion/c5/gt/lcms/vulnerability_FZ_13/xyza_flt_copy_alpha.bin; adapted: testbed/testcms2.c CheckFloatXYZ, the call that fails in the exploit's run: cmsCreateTransform(input, TYPE_XYZA_FLT, xyzProfile, TYPE_XYZA_FLT, INTENT_RELATIVE_COLORIMETRIC, cmsFLAGS_COPY_ALPHA) with the test's pixel {1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.5}: 0x0049009C, 0x0049009C, 0x04000000, 1 as uint32 little-endian, then the four floats (32 bytes). Checked locally: secure prints xform=OK and the pixel 1,1,1,0.5; injected prints lcms error 13: Mismatched alpha channels and xform=NULL.)

ground_truth.how_found: c5_specs.json: newplatform_bundles/conversion/c5/gt/lcms/vulnerability_FZ_13/xyza_flt_copy_alpha.bin; adapted: testbed/testcms2.c CheckFloatXYZ, the call that fails in the exploit's run: cmsCreateTransform(input, TYPE_XYZA_FLT, xyzProfile, TYPE_XYZA_FLT, INTENT_RELATIVE_COLORIMETRIC, cmsFLAGS_COPY_ALPHA) with the test's pixel {1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.5}: 0x0049009C, 0x0049009C, 0x04000000, 1 as uint32 little-endian, then the four floats (32 bytes). Checked locally: secure prints xform=OK and the pixel 1,1,1,0.5; injected prints lcms error 13: Mismatched alpha channels and xform=NULL.

category5.design: The transform harnesses pass arbitrary formats and flags to cmsCreateTransform but only check for NULL, so a driver adapted from the failing CheckFloatXYZ takes the formats, flags and intent (the harness header layout) and one pixel from the PoV and prints the outcome; output-diff.
